mapper.select: select source, channel, goods_id, goods_name, original_price, status from sku
mapper.insert: insert into sku(source, channel, goods_id, goods_name, original_price, status) values(#{source}, #{channel}, #{goodsId}, #{goodsName}, #{originalPrice}, #{status})
mapper.update: update sku set goods_name = #{goodsName}, original_price = #{originalPrice}, update_time = now() where goods_id = #{goodsId}
